advancements.rainbow.description: Catch a rainbow Pokemon, or successfully use a Rainbow Wing to give your own Pokemon the rainbow palette.
advancements.spiky_pichu.description: Catch a Spiky-eared Pichu, or obtain one by using Forage at an Ilex Shrine with a Pichu at 255 friendship.
advancements.zombie.description: Catch a zombie-palette Pokemon, or successfully transform your own Pokemon with a Jack o Lantern on a full-moon night, outdoors at light level 12 or higher.
